ideas.name: Small Hours
ideas.tagline: Make room for the project you keep putting off.
ideas.problem: Side projects may stall because the next step feels too large or unclear.
ideas.solution: A calm daily prompt that turns a rough intention into a single small action.
ideas.whyNow: Test whether makers want a simpler alternative to large planning tools.
ideas.distribution: Recruit five willing makers from a relevant community after permission.
ideas.priceHypothesis: Test a one-off purchase; price sensitivity is unknown.
ideas.falsificationTest: Give five makers a five-day manual version; stop if fewer than two return without reminders.
uncertainties: The problem has not been validated with intended users.
Existing alternatives and willingness to pay require research.

sources.title: Deployment capability reference

challenges.rationale: Illustrative score only. This concept needs customer research before a commercial test.
challenges.strongestObjection: An existing tool or a simple manual process may already solve the problem adequately.

pages.eyebrow: FOR THE THING YOU KEEP MEANING TO MAKE
pages.headline: A little time. Something of your own.
pages.subhead: Turn the idea at the back of your mind into one small, useful step today.

benefits.title: Name the thing
benefits.body: Give the important detail a place to live, with enough context to use it later.

benefits.title: Make the step smaller
benefits.body: Work through one focused question and leave with a clearer direction.

benefits.title: Leave a trail
benefits.body: Turn the idea into a small experiment you can actually try.

steps: Bring one real problem you want to work on.
Work through a short, focused first session.
Leave with one useful next action.
